# Starward residual implementation handoff

> Identity: `STARWARD-DR-RESIDUAL-HANDOFF-V1`
> Intent: implementation handoff over already-selected resources; no new full UI generation
> Status: ready for explicit `/long-task-workflow` input after the validations recorded below
> Date: 2026-07-26

## 1. Outcome

The initial product/technical target already has complete selected design-source coverage: 14/14 surfaces, 95/95 stable controls, 19 assemblies and 240 scenarios. The 2026-07-26 product-authority refresh makes the primary-navigation interpretation explicit: Tonight, Map, Trips, Sky, and Me are distinct route/screen roots with independent tab stacks and scroll/canvas state, not sections or conditional pseudo-pages in one shared `ScrollView`. The remaining UI/UX work is implementation, production conformance and typed runtime/backend acceptance—not another design pass. This handoff freezes the exact inputs, conditions, locators, eight-dimension accounting, verification methods and 22 downstream blocker lineages needed by a later Single-Goal Delivery Contract.

No Figma file, wireframe, high-fidelity direction, component atlas, icon set, logo, illustration or location media was generated. Open Design was used as the provenance/editable-upstream authority for the four existing projects; no new project or run was started.

1. `mobile-page-constraint`: 12 mobile surface frames/routes/regions/composition; implementation-app machine-readable profile.
2. `mobile-control-exact`: 83 exact mobile controls; implementation-app profile; historical mobile v3 qualifier remains **artifact-ready/run-unreconciled**.

Two supporting reference profiles make the durable authority recoverable without pretending to be selected implementation targets: `design-authority-reference` and `product-source-reference`.

Editable upstream is not the frozen repo copy. Update the corresponding Open Design project, export a new immutable version, reacquire and verify its full closure, then revise canonical adoption through UI Authority. Never overwrite an adopted baseline.

## 6. Delivery and runtime profile

- Owner-only personal trial.
- External data/service ceiling: CNY 200/month and CNY 2400/year.
- Paid default: CNY 0; owner approval is required before any paid activation.
- Android: production runtime and representative-device acceptance required.
- iOS: product/design/interaction/component/code/build semantics are in scope; live build/runtime/device evidence is deferred/unverified, never passed or not-applicable.
- No client-side source stitching, fake/guaranteed data, lowest-price-only provider choice, static-screen completion, online-only field mode or owner-approval bypass.

## 8. Subject and responsibility accounting

- Surface subjects: 14, exactly one per Product Surface.
- Control subjects: 95, exactly one per stable control—83 mobile and 12 ops.
- Page constraints own surface frame/hierarchy/route/regions/composition and actually displayed page states.
- Exact control targets own anatomy, props, owner/event boundaries, state/interaction, motion, accessibility, platform/content/assets and scenarios inside declared fields.
- Supporting DESIGN/Context references constrain interpretation and cannot replace selected-target evidence.
- Every subject × target × declared condition × eight dimensions has exactly one disposition in the strict block.

## 9. Condition accounting

Mobile conditions include 360/390/430, tablet and landscape; Android full/reduced; iOS semantic full/reduced; planning/night/red-light; all 19 declared state semantics; touch/keyboard/screen-reader/drag/back/deep-link/capability denial; zh-CN, 1.6× expansion, long names, timezone/units/freshness/error IDs; 44px, 200%, semantics, non-color, safe-area, focus, reduced transparency and red-light flash constraints.

Ops conditions include 1440×900, 1180 compact, 1024×768, 820×900 and reduced motion; common and guarded states; pointer/keyboard/focus/Escape; 200% zoom and bounded overflow; role/field/MFA/deny-by-default; long IDs, timezone, source/version/freshness and visibly sample-only content.

## 10. Verification method catalogue

Each method is a future independently failing Assertion. Resource integrity/preflight never proves production conformance.

| Method ID | Positive fact | Forbidden substitute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dr-resource-integrity` | File bytes, path, media type, JSON/HTML readability and SHA-256 all match. | Provider project presence cannot replace this. |
| `dr-source-profile-closure` | Canonical entry, every dependency and acquisition=complete match exactly. | A screenshot or URL cannot replace this. |
| `dr-stable-key-bijection` | 14 surfaces and 95 controls have no missing, extra, duplicate or ambiguous owner. | A prose list cannot replace machine comparison. |
| `dr-surface-flow` | Root entry, route, back/deep link, regions and cross-page result. | A detached specimen cannot replace the production journey. |
| `dr-visual-content` | Hierarchy, copy, mode and visual comparison under the declared condition. | A hash alone cannot replace render comparison. |
| `dr-component-control` | Anatomy, props, variants, owner, event and boundary. | Seeing one button on a page cannot replace the contract. |
| `dr-state-interaction` | Trigger, input, validation, loading, empty, success, failure and recovery. | A static default frame cannot replace the state journey. |
| `dr-motion-full` | Property, endpoints, timing, interruption, reversal and settle under full motion. | A nominal duration string cannot replace the motion trace. |
| `dr-motion-reduced` | A meaningful reduced-motion replacement under reduced conditions. | A full-motion pass cannot replace it. |
| `dr-adaptation-input` | Viewport, safe area, keyboard, gesture/input and overflow behavior. | A single 390px screenshot cannot replace the matrix. |
| `dr-accessibility` | Role, name, order, state, 44px, 200%, contrast, focus and reduced behavior. | DOM presence cannot replace semantic/interactive proof. |
| `dr-assets-license` | Asset identity, license/source, replacement and mode treatment. | A visible placeholder cannot replace lawful production media. |
| `dr-design-conformance` | Production actual is compared against the exact/constraint target with attributable failure. | Resource preflight cannot replace production conformance. |
| `dr-mobile-native-device` | Representative Android gesture/sensor/camera/haptic/accessibility/performance behavior. | Web atlas or simulator-only evidence cannot replace it. |
| `dr-ops-backend-effect` | Real endpoint/auth/effect/idempotency/audit/rollback/recovery. | Local sample flow cannot replace it. |
| `dr-root-cold-start-journey` | The real production root entry cold-starts and completes the target outcome. | A deep link or detached route cannot replace it. |
| `dr-shared-context-consistency` | Tonight/Map/Spot/Route/Trip/Sky share location, time and revision consistently. | A single page's local state cannot replace it. |

## 13. Forbidden inferences

- HTML rendering is not React Native implementation completion.
- Hash/preflight is not production fidelity, correctness or acceptance.
- Sample Beijing/Qingshuihe/time/score/people are not business facts.
- Old `unselected candidate` wording does not override later DESIGN adoption.
- Mobile v3 provider run is not asserted succeeded.
- Web motion constants are not native tuning constants.
- iOS runtime deferral does not remove iOS design/code/build scope.
- Placeholder or generated art is not lawful production location media.
- Ops deterministic samples do not prove real permission/audit/release/recovery.
- PWA, mini-program, static kit or detached route cannot replace the RN app.
- CNY 200/month is a cap, not payment authorization.

Contract-facing target projection: the four immutable selected resource families remain unchanged; the strict target profiles below are partitioned by owning Outcome so every Claim, condition, method and blocker is attributable without creating a second design authority.

## 15. Strict implementation handoff

```yaml design-resource-handoff-v1
schema_version: design-resource-handoff-v1
intent: implementation_handoff
scope:
  key: starward-residual-implementation-handoff
  style_dependency: style-bearing
  surface_keys:
    - mobile-shell-and-preferences
    - tonight-decision
    - forecast-and-astronomy
    - map-route-discovery
    - spot-detail-and-trust
    - itinerary-and-collaboration
    - sky-orientation-ar
    - shooting-assistant
    - field-offline-safety
    - community-contribution
    - notifications-and-toolbox
    - identity-profile-privacy
    - admin-data-operations
    - quality-release-observability
  necessary_context:
    - Four formal Source inputs are indexed by path, role and authoring-snapshot digest in the readable source items.
    - "Current delivery profile is an owner-only personal trial: CNY 200 per month / CNY 2400 per year total external-data ceiling; paid default is CNY 0 and any paid use requires owner approval."
    - Android production runtime evidence is required. iOS product/design/interaction/code/build semantics remain in scope; live iOS runtime evidence is deferred/unverified.
    - DESIGN.md is the exact token and selected-target adoption authority; Product Surface and Screen Contracts own information/action/feedback and screen responsibility.
    - Four immutable selected targets provide 14 surfaces, 95 stable controls, 19 assemblies and 240 scenarios. No duplicate full UI resource generation is authorized.
    - Open Design live provider 0.15.1 still exposes all four editable projects and user:design-md. Historical run status is frozen in the external goal index; mobile control v3 is artifact-ready/run-unreconciled.
    - The initial authoring proposal is a mutable proposal path carried separately from immutable target resource closure to avoid circular proposal/handoff hashes.
  exclusions:
    - No new full mobile or operations UI, wireframe, high-fidelity direction, component atlas, icon set, logo, illustration or Figma file.
    - No generated or atmospheric image may represent lawful production location media.
    - No Web motion constant, local deterministic sample flow, hash, preflight or detached route may prove native physics, production backend effect or final product acceptance.
    - No automatic purchase, paid provider activation or owner-approval bypass; the CNY 200 monthly ceiling is a cap, not spending authorization.
    - No modification of Source Plan, frozen selected targets, production code, tests or Long-Task Contract in this authoring delivery.
provenance:
  provider: Open Design local daemon
  provider_version: 0.15.1
  project: four existing selected projects; per-target project IDs are preserved in resource editable_upstream locators
  run: historical target-specific runs preserved in the frozen Open Design goal index
  capability: residual implementation handoff indexing over already-selected immutable resources; no new visual generation
  agent: historical target-specific Codex records; current authoring performed by Codex
  model: historical page runs gpt-5.6-sol; control run model is provider-unrecorded where frozen provenance says null
  design_system_id: user:design-md

conditions:
  - key: mobile-android-360-full
    platform: React Native Android; production runtime acceptance required
    viewport:
      width: 360
      height: 800
      unit: px
    motion: full
    modes:
      - planning
      - night
      - red-light
      - low-power instant alternative where declared
    states:
      - default
      - pressed
      - focus-visible
      - selected
      - disabled
      - loading
      - saving
      - success
      - error
      - stale
      - partial
      - degraded
      - unknown
      - empty
      - no-results
      - blocked
      - permission-denied
      - conflict
      - offline
    content_cases:
      - zh-CN default
      - 1.6x translation expansion and long place/model/user names
      - local date/time with explicit IANA timezone and locale-aware units/numbers
      - stale/source/version/confidence/error ID visible where applicable
      - 44px minimum target and 200 percent text without clipping
      - semantic name/order/state and non-color-only encoding
      - safe-area, keyboard avoidance, focus return and reduced transparency
      - red-light mode forbids bright white or blue flash
    input_methods:
      - touch
      - keyboard and accessibility activation
      - screen reader
      - drag scrub and direct manipulation
      - system back and deep link
      - sensor camera and map permission deny/degrade
```
